text:
deploy-bot: publish blocked for image redwood/service-api:20260320-rc3 - provenance validation failed: label 'org.redwood.release-notes' length 2048 > 1024 allowed.

maya: ack, saw the alert. full log?

ci-bot: log snippet:
```
> validation failed: metadata.labels['org.redwood.release-notes'] length=2048 limit=1024
> offending value starts: '# Release notes

- big feature... (long markdown included inline)...'
```

sam: ohhh we inlined the entire markdown in the label to preserve offline provenance. that was dumb.

lee: we only need a reference, not the whole doc. can we republish with a short url label instead?

maya: two constraints: 1) can't mutate existing digest, so republish = new tag. 2) we should avoid splatting long blobs into labels (provenance guard enforces size).

sam: plan A: strip label and republish same buildid under tag `20260320-rc3-rnshort`. update release metadata service to host the full notes at a short URL and write the URL into `org.redwood.release-notes-url` label.

lee: Plan B: truncate label (risky, loses content). not acceptable for compliance.

ops-oncall: recommend doing republish during 00:00-02:00 UTC change window tonight to minimize rollout overlap, unless it's a hotfix.

maya: not a hotfix. let's follow Plan A. steps:
1) generate short signed URL in release-metadata service (expires in 30d).
2) run `docker tag` / `aws ecr put-image` to push new tag using same digest: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-tag 20260320-rc3-rnshort --image-manifest $(aws ecr batch-get-image --image-ids imageTag=20260320-rc3 --query images[0].imageManifest --output text)`
3) update release database record with new tag -> notes_url.
4) notify QA to smoke canary tomorrow morning.

sam: I'll own the short URL and the DB update.

ci-bot: note: CI pipeline currently sets `org.redwood.release-notes` from $RELEASE_NOTES_CONTENT. please change to set `org.redwood.release-notes-url` pointing to $RELEASE_NOTES_SHORT_URL. I'll create a PR to the pipeline config.

lee: can we add a linter to fail CI if any label > 1k bytes? makes sense.

maya: yes, add that to the release pipeline. also add a deploy-bot rule to surface label length mismatches earlier (pre-publish).

ops-oncall: scheduling: sam, can you do the republish at 00:15 UTC? I'll book the change window and post the ops runbook.

sam: yep 00:15 UTC works. tagging/publishing command I'll run and paste here when done.

deploy-bot: blocking state recorded. will re-run validation on new tag.

lee: quick TODO for after: migrate old builds in S3 that had inline notes to hosted notes and add redirect mapping. low priority.
